div.head: II Cn 15.1
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe unlage rǽre oððe undóm gedeme héonan forð, for læððe oððe for feohfange, beo se wið ðone cyng hundtwelftig scill' scyldig on Engla láge, buton he míd aðe cyðan durre, þæt he hit na rihtor ne cuðe, ⁊ ðolie áá his þegenscipes, butan he híne æt ðam cýng gebycge, swa he him geðafian wylle.

And he who henceforth promotes injustice or pronounces unjust judgments, as the result of malice or bribery, shall forfeit 120 shillings to the king, in districts under English law, unless he is prepared to declare on oath that he did not know how to give a more just verdict, and he shall lose for ever his rank as a thegn, unless he redeem it from the king, provided the latter is willing to allow him to do so.

And se ðe unlage rære oððe undom gedeme heonan forð, for læððe oððe for feohfange, beo se wið þone cingc CXX scyll' scyldig on Engla lage, butan he mid aðe cyðan durre, þæt he hit na rihtor ne cuþe, ⁊ þolige aa his þegnscipes, butan he hine æt þam cingce eft gebicge, swa he him geþafian wylle.
